# Minimum Wall Thickness

Minimum distance between opposing surfaces.

<figure markdown="span">
![Minimum Wall Thickness: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/min-wall-thickness-light.svg#only-light){ width="640" }
![Minimum Wall Thickness: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/min-wall-thickness-dark.svg#only-dark){ width="640" }
<figcaption>Thinnest section, measured by a ray cast from one surface to the opposite one.</figcaption>
</figure>

## Where it applies

| Process | Criticality |
| :-- | :-- |
| [Plastic Injection Molding](../../reference/processes/plastic-injection-molding.md) | High |
| [FDM](../../reference/processes/fdm-3d-printing.md) | Critical |
| [Resin 3D Printing (SLA)](../../reference/processes/resin-3d-printing.md) | Critical |
| [Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)](../../reference/processes/powder-bed-fusion.md) | Critical |

## Values

**Aim for** is what to design for; crossing it gives a warning. **At least** is the hard limit; crossing it gives an error. See [aim for and limits](../../concepts/aim-for-and-limits.md).

=== "Plastic Injection Molding"

    Criticality in this process: **High** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | At least | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 1.0 mm | 0.5 mm | Not yet sourced |
    | ABS | 1.14 mm | 0.8 mm | Aim for: Published, [Protolabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#protolabs-wall-thickness "ABS: 0.045 in")<br>At least: Not yet sourced |
    | Acetal / POM | 0.76 mm | 0.5 mm | Aim for: Published, [Protolabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#protolabs-wall-thickness "Acetal: 0.030 in")<br>At least: Not yet sourced |
    | PMMA | 0.64 mm | 0.4 mm | Aim for: Published, [Protolabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#protolabs-wall-thickness "Acrylic: 0.025 in")<br>At least: Not yet sourced |
    | LCP | 0.76 mm | 0.5 mm | Aim for: Published, [Protolabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#protolabs-wall-thickness "Liquid crystal polymer: 0.030 in")<br>At least: Not yet sourced |
    | Long-Fiber Reinforced Plastics | 1.91 mm | 1.5 mm | Aim for: Published, [Protolabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#protolabs-wall-thickness "Long-fiber reinforced plastics: 0.075 in")<br>At least: Not yet sourced |
    | PA | 0.76 mm | 0.5 mm | Aim for: Published, [Protolabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#protolabs-wall-thickness "Nylon: 0.030 in")<br>At least: Not yet sourced |
    | PC | 1.02 mm | 0.7 mm | Aim for: Published, [Protolabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#protolabs-wall-thickness "Polycarbonate: 0.040 in")<br>At least: Not yet sourced |
    | PET / PBT | 0.64 mm | 0.4 mm | Aim for: Published, [Protolabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#protolabs-wall-thickness "Polyester: 0.025 in")<br>At least: Not yet sourced |
    | PE | 0.76 mm | 0.5 mm | Aim for: Published, [Protolabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#protolabs-wall-thickness "Polyethylene: 0.030 in")<br>At least: Not yet sourced |
    | PSU | 0.51 mm | 0.3 mm | Not yet sourced |
    | PP | 0.89 mm | 0.6 mm | Not yet sourced |
    | PS | 0.89 mm | 0.6 mm | Aim for: Published, [Protolabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#protolabs-wall-thickness "Polystyrene: 0.035 in")<br>At least: Not yet sourced |
    | PUR | 2.03 mm | 1.5 mm | Aim for: Published, [Protolabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#protolabs-wall-thickness "Polyurethane: 0.080 in")<br>At least: Not yet sourced |

    Every other material uses the Default values: PLA, PVC.


=== "FDM"

    Criticality in this process: **Critical** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    !!! info "Worked out at analysis time"

        Derived from nozzle diameter during DFM analysis setup. The values below are used only when there is nothing to work them out from.
    | Material | Aim for | At least | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 1.2 mm | 0.8 mm | Not yet sourced |
    | TPU (Flexible) | 1.6 mm | 1.2 mm | Not yet sourced |

    Every other material uses the Default values: PLA, PLA-CF (Carbon Fiber), PETG, ABS, ASA, PA, PA-CF (Carbon Fiber), PC.


=== "Resin 3D Printing (SLA)"

    Criticality in this process: **Critical** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | At least | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 0.6 mm | 0.4 mm | Aim for: Published, [Xometry](../../citations/bibliography.md#xometry-sla "0.6 mm unsupported walls")<br>At least: Published, [Xometry](../../citations/bibliography.md#xometry-sla "0.4 mm supported walls") |

    Every other material uses the Default values: Standard Resin, Tough / Durable Resin, Flexible / Elastic Resin.


=== "Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)"

    Criticality in this process: **Critical** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | At least | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 1.0 mm | 0.6 mm | Aim for: Published, [HLH Prototypes](../../citations/bibliography.md#hlh-sls "1 mm recommended")<br>At least: Published, [Formlabs](../../citations/bibliography.md#formlabs-fuse "0.6 mm vertical walls") |
    | PA12 (MJF) | 1.5 mm | 0.5 mm | Aim for: Published, [Xometry](../../citations/bibliography.md#xometry-mjf "1.5 mm recommended")<br>At least: Published, [Xometry](../../citations/bibliography.md#xometry-mjf "0.5 mm minimum") |
    | PA12 Carbon-filled | 2.5 mm | 2.0 mm | Aim for: Engineering judgement<br>At least: Published, [Hubs](../../citations/bibliography.md#hubs-sls "2 mm minimum walls for carbon-filled polyamide") |

    Every other material uses the Default values: PA12 (SLS), PA11, TPU.


## Messages

What the results panel says about a finding. You can rewrite these in the Process Library; the words in `{braces}` are filled in for each finding.

=== "Plastic Injection Molding"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Thin Wall Section (`{measured}`): This area is below the recommended `{target}`. Thin walls increase flow resistance and may lead to "short shots" or unintended cooling before the cavity is fully packed.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Critical Thinning (`{measured}`): Wall thickness is below the `{limit}` threshold. The high injection pressure required to fill this area may cause structural weakness or "hesitation" marks in the final part.

=== "FDM"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Wall thickness `{measured}` is below the recommended `{target}` (2x nozzle diameter). Too narrow to fit two extrusion widths, so perimeters will not fuse properly. Expect poor layer bonding and a rough surface.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Wall thickness `{measured}` is below the `{limit}` minimum (1x nozzle diameter). The slicer cannot lay down a single extrusion line in this gap and will either skip it or force an under-extruded pass. Widen to at least one nozzle width.

=== "Resin 3D Printing (SLA)"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Thin wall (`{measured}`): below the recommended `{target}`. Thin resin walls warp under the peel forces and can swell in the cleaning alcohol. Thicken it, or support it on two or more sides.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Wall too thin (`{measured}`): below `{limit}`. It may warp, tear away during the peel or not print at all. Thicken it to at least `{target}`.

=== "Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Thin wall (`{measured}`): below the recommended `{target}`. Thin sintered walls are weak and can warp, or break when the powder is blasted off. Thicken it, or brace it with ribs.
    !!! failure "Error"

        Wall too thin (`{measured}`): below `{limit}`. It may not fuse, or may warp or snap off during depowdering. Thicken it to at least `{target}`.

| Placeholder | Replaced with |
| :-- | :-- |
| `{measured}` | The measured value, with its unit |
| `{target}` | The rule's "Aim for" value |
| `{limit}` | The rule's "At least" value |
